text: This country's lowest point is higher than Britain's highest mountain.
And it's completely surrounded by another country.
This is Lesotho, a kingdom of mountains inside South Africa.
Watch what happens if the sea starts to rise.
At one thousand metres, almost half of South Africa is underwater.
At fourteen hundred, about four fifths is gone, and Lesotho still hasn't got wet.
No country on Earth has a higher lowest point. And its peak tops three thousand four hundred metres.
So why is it a separate country? In eighteen sixty-eight, its king asked Britain for protection from the Boers.
That kept his mountain kingdom apart. In nineteen sixty-six it became independent, surrounded on every side.
They call it the Kingdom in the Sky.
Would you live in a country with no lowlands at all?
